title: Dil se Rave - A Desi EDM Festival Experience
description: SF's favorite desi rave goes nighttime for the festive season! Experience your favorite Bollywood anthems reworked with House and EDM energy
long_description:
SF's favorite desi rave goes nighttime for the festive season! Experience your favorite Bollywood anthems reworked with House and EDM energy

About this Event

On Saturday, November 14, we’re taking over The Foundry SF for our final rave of the year. It’s Diwali season, and also DSR’s one-year anniversary, so we’re putting together a proper carnival of lights and sounds to celebrate!

✨ What to Expect

⚡🎉The Space & Vibe:
We're trading the daytime sunshine for lasers and concrete at The Foundry SF in the heart of SoMa. This historic industrial warehouse comes equipped with an incredible heavy-hitting sound system, and is the perfect canvas for our signature Dil Se festival production, dialed up for the dark.

🎵🔥 The Sound:
Your favorite Bollywood and pop anthems, heavily reworked with deep house, tech house, and underground EDM energy. Check out your DJs on Instagram-
 https://www.instagram.com/lychyjelly/
 https://www.instagram.com/qa0tiq/
 https://www.instagram.com/demba.4600/

👕 The Look: Underground Rave meets Diwali Drip
A little desi, a little wild, and a whole lot of bass! ❤️‍🔥 Since we’re right in the middle of Diwali season, we have one signature dress code rule: grab your favorite dupatta, pashmina or scarf and turn it into your ultimate dance-floor accessory.

Beyond your drape, keep it rave-functional and wear whatever makes you feel unstoppable under the lasers:
Go Full Rave: Your favorite dark festival drip and clubwear paired with your pashmina or dupatta.Go Diwali-Lite: Breathable, comfortable Diwali fits reimagined for a late-night warehouse sweat.Footwear Check: Sneakers, boots, or comfortable shoes strictly recommended- come built for hours of heavy grooves and dirty bass

💫 If you've joined us in the past, you know the energy. If you missed it, now is your chance to see why this community is growing so fast.

✌️ We promise you'll leave with a lighter heart, tired legs, and a few new friends.
